scenes.title: Arrive after the carrier’s delay
scenes.objective: Use timing to remain available when an entry slows.
scenes.briefing: F1 has slowed in a wide attacking-zone lane to protect navy possession. YOU are arriving through the neutral zone. The exercise asks YOU to remain a passing option rather than overtake F1 immediately. Navy attacks the right net and defends the left net.

scenes.title: The point shot has a blocker
scenes.objective: Compare the current shooting lane with another angle.
scenes.briefing: YOU have the puck high in the zone. Gold 1 is directly between YOU and the net. D2 offers a lateral option while F1 is near the far side. Navy attacks Gold’s net and defends Navy’s net. This is a selected-player teaching view; no movement is implied unless stated.
